browser.title: Sign in using your browser
browser.body: Your browser will redirect you back to Git Desktop once you've signed in. If your browser asks for your permission to launch Git Desktop, please allow it.
browser.waiting: Waiting for you to authorize in the browser…
browser.selfHostedHint: Register an OAuth application with the callback URL git-desktop-auth://oauth, then paste its client ID here.

choose.title: Sign in to {{host}}
choose.hint: Git Desktop does not recognise this server. Pick what it runs.

token.title: Sign in to {{host}}
token.hint: Paste a personal access token with permission to read and write repositories.
token.where: Where do I get a token?
token.helpFailed: Could not open the token page
token.useBrowser: Sign in with the browser instead
token.useOwnApp: Sign in with your own OAuth app instead

section.notPersistent: This system has no keychain Git Desktop can use, so tokens are kept in memory only — you will need to sign in again after restarting.
section.repoHint: The account the repository {{repo}} signs in with. Every repository signs in on its own; terminals in its folder use the same login.
section.noRepo: Open a repository to sign it in. Every repository has its own account.
section.ssh: This repository connects over SSH with your key from ~/.ssh, so it needs no account.
section.noRemote: This repository has no remote, so there is nothing to sign in to.

connection.title: Repository connection
connection.protocolHint: SSH uses your key from ~/.ssh; HTTPS uses an account or the system credential store
connection.system: Git uses a login from the system credential store
connection.noneHint: Push and pull will fail until you sign in
connection.signOutHint: Signs this repository out of {{host}}; other repositories keep their accounts
connection.forgetConfirm: Erase the login for {{host}} from the system credential store? Git in a terminal uses it too.

error.mismatch: This server does not look like {{service}}. Check the address or pick another service.
error.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check the address and your connection.

existing.title: This repository is already signed in
existing.body: It signs in to {{host}} as {{name}} (@{{login}}). Signing in again replaces that account for this repository only.

card.rejected: The service rejected this stored login

test.readWriteBehind: read + write (the branch is behind the remote)

reason.orgAccess: the server did not give access to this repository
reason.auth: the server did not accept the login
reason.sshKey: the SSH key did not work
reason.notRepo: this folder is not a git repository

ssh.host-key: the host key of this server is not trusted yet
ssh.key-rejected: the SSH key was not accepted
ssh.unreachable: could not reach the server over SSH
ssh.unknown: could not tell whether the SSH key works

sshHint.host-key: Connect once from a terminal (ssh -T git@{{host}}) and confirm the host key.
sshHint.key-rejected: Add your public key to your account on {{host}} under SSH keys. If the key has a passphrase, add it to ssh-agent.
sshHint.unreachable: Check your network connection and the remote address.
sshHint.unknown: Run ssh -T git@{{host}} in a terminal to see what the server says.

test.orgAccessHint: If this repository belongs to an organization, it may need to approve Git Desktop. Otherwise check that the repository exists.
test.authHint: Sign in again, or forget the stored login and sign in.
